findings.problem: Web directly imports private storage, resolves an alias into it, and stores orders in routes.
findings.principle: UI never touches storage; use public core interface.
findings.consequence: Extensions can bypass the approved boundary.
findings.fix: Expose servicePrice and order creation via the existing core index; move order storage into core; make web adapters use that interface. Retain public.ts as the representative example and document it in DESIGN.md. Extend the existing native checker to reject web imports of non-index core files, including bridge bypasses.
findings.verification: Native boundaries and types pass; valid public/sibling imports pass; deliberate private and alias violations fail; checkout remains 10.

findings.problem: Core a and b call each other recursively.
findings.principle: Proposed: core dependency graph must remain acyclic, enforced by the existing native check.
findings.consequence: Calling either helper never terminates and boundary checks fail.
findings.fix: Retain both exports and filenames; make b a terminating leaf (proposed result 12), with a delegating to b. Record this rule and its scope in DESIGN.md.
findings.verification: Native cycle proof fails only on seeded cycle; helper calls terminate with selected result.

findings.problem: Real journey price server supplies 12, conflicting with checkout acceptance total 10.
findings.consequence: Mocked unit success masks the failed user journey.
findings.fix: Set the journey test server price to 10; preserve its expected total 10 and production quote 12. Add representative public-interface checkout coverage. Do not hardcode a 10 result in production.
findings.verification: Captured failing before reproduction and passing after real local HTTP journey using unchanged expected total.

findings.problem: Order names both a customer purchase and UI panel sequence.
findings.principle: Use one unambiguous canonical term per concept.
findings.consequence: Extension authors cannot identify the intended domain meaning.
findings.fix: Keep Order for customer purchase; rename the UI sequencing concept to Panel order in existing glossary.md. Use supported bold-term Markdown for native duplicate-term checking without changing either definition.
findings.verification: Owner selects the terminology; final docs checker and impact assessment cite unchanged purchase meaning.

findings.consequence: Future work can pass check while violating design; clean-clone review cannot reproduce maintenance evidence.
findings.fix: Extend existing npm run check with fail-fast types, boundaries, units and journey; retain separate scripts. Add selected .bstack contract, installed standalone checker and portable assessment; point AGENTS.md to existing design/glossary/example and commands; create docs/repo-audit.md only after final assessment. Preserve CLAUDE.md import stub.
